## Activity

During May 2022, Oakridge Primary Care recorded 56 captures. Activity was completed through the site’s planned session lists, which ran as expected apart from routine leave. The recorded volume provides the basis for the image-quality and grading measures outlined below. No additional operational issue is noted in the information available for this report.

## Image quality

Of the captures completed, 1 was assessed as ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 1.8. The result indicates that nearly all submitted captures were suitable for grading. The ungradable capture should remain visible in local quality monitoring so that any recurring issues with image acquisition can be identified and addressed through routine review.

## Grading

A total of 10 results were graded referable. The median lag from capture to grading was 23 days. These figures should be considered alongside the activity level and the image-quality result when reviewing service performance for May 2022. Overall, the report records completed activity at Oakridge Primary Care, with one ungradable capture and referable findings identified during grading.
